subject: PO request: SF Roadshow — cost center coding & PO creation
messages:
From: Julia Park <julia@brightwaveevents.com>
To: tessa_morgan@redwoodinference.com
Date: Mon, 9 Jun 2025 10:23:00 -0700
Subject: SF Roadshow proposal + initial invoice

Hi Tessa,

Thanks for the quick call this morning — attached is our formal proposal for the Redwood SF Roadshow (3 city activation, venue + A/V + staffing) and an initial invoice showing the 50% deposit required to lock the venue. Total estimated event cost: $48,000.

Key line items (summary):
- Venue rental + A/V: $22,000
- Production & staffing: $12,000
- Catering: $8,000
- Promotion & signage: $3,000
- Misc / contingency: $3,000

We can accept a standard PO with net-30 terms and will provide a W-9 for payments. I attached the proposal and vendor W-9 for your finance team. Please let me know if you need the deposit paid sooner — we can accept a 50% deposit to hold the space.

Best,
Julia Park
Senior Account Manager
BrightWave Events
Attachments: BrightWave_SF_Roadshow_Proposal.pdf; vendor_w9_brightwave.pdf

From: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwoodinference.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwoodinference.com>, laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com
Cc: marcus_lin@redwoodinference.com
Date: Mon, 9 Jun 2025 13:07:42 -0700
Subject: Fwd: SF Roadshow proposal + initial invoice — need PO and cost center coding

Vanessa / Laura — forwarding BrightWave's proposal. We’re planning a 3-city roadshow (SF, Portland, Seattle) in August; the vendor is requesting a 50% deposit to confirm venues. Total estimated spend across the event: $48,000.

Asking for:
1) Finance approval to create PO and confirm cost center coding (we should charge to field marketing / events).
2) Confirmation we can approve the 50% deposit on PO-creation (vendor requires deposit to hold the dates).
3) Any procurement steps I’m missing (W-9 received, proposal attached).

Attached is my line-item budget for the activation (event_budget_breakdown.xlsx). We’re aiming to get the PO issued by EOD Wednesday so deposit can be remitted.

Notes: this comes from the field marketing discretionary budget for Q3; campaign owner is me (Tessa Morgan). If you want to push down line items I can revise.

Thanks — can you advise next steps?

— Tessa
Field Marketing Manager
Redwood Inference
Attachments: event_budget_breakdown.xlsx

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwoodinference.com>
To: tessa_morgan@redwoodinference.com, laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com
Date: Tue, 10 Jun 2025 09:12:15 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: SF Roadshow proposal + initial invoice — need PO and cost center coding

Thanks Tessa — I reviewed the proposal and the budget. A few items from finance/procurement:

- We need the vendor's W-9 (Julia attached it, thanks). Please ensure the vendor completes the payee name exactly as their W-9.
- Cost center: please confirm which cost center you want to charge. For field marketing events we typically use ENG-MKT-040 or SALES-FT-210 depending on campaign owner.
- Spend cap: $48k is fine but I’ll need one of the following approvals: VP marketing or director-level sign-off for spend > $25k.
- Payment terms: procurement prefers net-30 on a confirmed PO; deposits are allowed but must be explicitly listed on the PO as “deposit - non-refundable if canceled less than 60 days.”

Action items for you:
1) Confirm cost center (ENG-MKT-040 or SALES-FT-210).
2) Provide VP/DIRECTOR approval email (Laura — can you confirm?) or route to laura for sign-off.
3) If approved, I will generate PO draft and send to Marcus for formal creation and issuance.

I’m happy to reduce contingency line if we need to keep the PO under $40k, but given timelines the fastest path is get Laura's sign-off and we’ll issue PO with deposit line.

— Vanessa
Senior Finance Business Partner
Redwood Inference

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com>
To: tessa_morgan@redwoodinference.com, vanessa_ortiz@redwoodinference.com
Cc: marcus_lin@redwoodinference.com
Date: Tue, 10 Jun 2025 11:45:02 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: SF Roadshow proposal + initial invoice — need PO and cost center coding

Tessa / Vanessa — I approve the vendor engagement and associated spend. Approved details:
- Approved amount: not to exceed $48,000 (final invoice can vary with receipts but notify finance for any change > 5%).
- Cost center: ENG-MKT-040 (Field Marketing).
- Spend category: Events / External Services.
- Payment terms: PO with 50% deposit; remaining 50% net-30 after the event.

Marcus — please create PO and route to BrightWave for signature. Marcus, add the deposit line item and include the vendor W-9 in the PO package.

Tessa — proceed with vendor confirmation once Marcus confirms PO number and DocuSign link for contract.

— Laura
VP, Growth & Marketing
Redwood Inference

From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwoodinference.com>
To: tessa_morgan@redwoodinference.com, laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com
Cc: vanessa_ortiz@redwoodinference.com
Date: Wed, 11 Jun 2025 16:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: SF Roadshow proposal + initial invoice — PO created (PO-2025-8742)

Thanks all — I created PO number PO-2025-8742 and drafted the PO document (attached stub). Next steps:
- I uploaded the PO draft to Drive and generated a DocuSign envelope for the vendor: https://www.docusign.net/agree/embedded?doc=0A12B
- I confirmed the cost center is ENG-MKT-040 and coded the spend category as Events / Marketing.
- I attached the draft PO (PO-2025-8742-draft.pdf). Finance will process 50% deposit payment once we receive the vendor-signed DocuSign.

Vendor action items for BrightWave: sign DocuSign, return W-9 confirmation, and remit any contract redlines within 48 hours so we can process deposit on Friday.

Let me know if anyone needs a revised PO (reclassifying line items) before sending.

— Marcus
Procurement Specialist
Redwood Inference
Attachments: PO-2025-8742-draft.pdf
